result.text: Systems performance team: We need to audit the Linux kernel EBPF network telemetry daemon before merging into mainline. First, check C header definitions in include /telemetry.h to verify that struct packet flow identifier declares 32-bit source IP address 16-bit destination IP address 64-bit source port and 16-bit destination port. Ensure that EBPF map definitions in kernel/maps.c configure packet counter map as a BPF map type, percpu hash with max entries configured to 1,000,000 entries and pin map flag set to BPF obj pin any. In the Rust userspace collector daemon, inspect /usr/src/daemon/collector.rs and verify that ring buffer consumer initializes with buffer size of 16 MB to prevent dropped packet events under bursty workloads. The userspace daemon must accept command line arguments --promotexport on port 9101, --bpftracepoint configured to netif receive skb. In the EBPF kernel probe program, verify that TCP connection tracker inspects tcphdr flags to accurately count SYN and ACK packets without triggering kernel verifier rejections for unbounded loop execution. The principal systems engineer confirmed that BPF verifier log level must be set to 1 during debugging sessions. The daemon must also track socket buffer allocations in sk_buff structures and emit histogram distributions for connection establishment latency. Under no circumstances should any developer disable kernel BPF verifier safety checks using debug kernel parameters. In addition, inspect build scripts in makefile and cargo.toml to verify that Clang compiles BPF objects with --cpp2 and --target-bpf flags. The userspace Rust daemon must handle UNIX signals sigint and sigterm gracefully by closing ring buffer subscriptions and unpinning BPF maps from sysfs BPF telemetry. Verify that synthetic traffic benchmarks generated by iperf3 reach 10 Gbps per second throughput with CPU utilization remaining under 5% across all worker cores. All metrics exported to Prometheus must adhere to Open Telemetry semantic conventions using snake_case metric names including network packets total and TCP connection duration seconds. Incident response coordinators must also confirm that kernel warning messages are monitored in /var/log messages via systemd journald telemetry pipes. The infrastructure security group requires that the binary collector executable run under non root service accounts using Linux capabilities --cap BPF --cap net admin and --cap perfmon. In addition, the integration test harness in tests/ebpf_test.rs must execute in GitHub workflows using GitHub Actions runners with kernel version 5.15 or newer. Furthermore, verify that helper functions in libbpf.c utilize BPF trace printk strictly for development builds and remove all kernel printk calls from release binaries. The Rust daemon must also implement exponential backoff reconnection logic when communication with the local Prometheus node exporter fails, starting with initial interval of 100 milliseconds capped at 10 seconds. Inspect dockerfile.daemon to ensure multi-stage Docker builds discard Clang compilation dependencies and produce minimal scratch-based deployment containers. The site reliability team requires automated alerts in Datadog when ring buffer dropped event ratio exceeds 0.01% over 5-minute intervals. In the kernel probe directory, examine filter.c to verify that sock filter bytecodes validate IPv4 and IPv6 header checksums before processing payload slices. All BPF tail calls must use static jump tables with a maximum depth limit of 32 calls to prevent kernel stack overflow errors. The memory management team requires that memory Cgroup limits for the collector daemon be configured to 512 MB in systemd unit definitions. Inspect scripts/deploy/telemetry.service to verify that restart policy is set to on failure with restart security delay of 5 seconds. The network operations center confirmed that BPF map dumps must be exportable to JSON format using BPFtool --map_dump_id for offline incident analysis. Moreover, the collector daemon must log all unrecognized packet protocols to audit log files with rate limiting capped at 10 messages per second. Verify that Clang optimization passes preserve volatile memory pointers when reading hardware timestamps from BPF ktime get ns helper calls. Security compliance requires that all BPF program bytecode binaries be cryptographically signed using kernel module signing keys before loading into memory. The automated fuzzing suite in tests/fuzz/packet_fuzzer.c must run continuously for 48 hours without triggering kernel panics. In addition, check file reference /sysctl.conf in the system configuration directory to confirm that NetCore BPF JIT enable is set to 1. The platform security auditor requires that BPF program load events be logged to auditd daemon with process identity and file path. Moreover, the collector daemon must verify that kernel page table isolation is active before allocating shared BPF ring buffer memory maps. Finally, schedule an architectural review with the Linux platform infrastructure manager on Wednesday at 2 PM to approve production deployment across edge gateway nodes.
